No 402 payment quote is ever reached — the gateway 502s before quoting, so no payment occurs.

usage.guide: This endpoint is currently broken. GET https://flight.memoryapi.org/x402/flight/flights returns 502 Bad Gateway from nginx on every attempt — the upstream flight service behind the x402 gateway is down. Do not attempt to pay; the gateway 502s before issuing a 402 quote, so no money is at risk but no data is returned. If it comes back online, intended use is a GET with optional query params airport (IATA code, default JFK), direction (Departure|Arrival, default Departure), hours (1-12, default 6), reading results from body.flights[].
